_comment: Earnings calendar for scripts/watch.py. Timing only — never theses.
print_at is the expected announcement in UTC and MUST carry an offset.
AMC prints are ~20:20Z while the US is on EDT (16:20 ET).
Verify each date against company IR before relying on it; aggregator
dates were wrong often enough last season to warrant the habit.

watchlist.label: FQ2-27
watchlist.note: 10-Q lands SAME DAY as the print (FQ2-26: both 2025-08-27; FQ2-25: both 2024-08-28), so the engine has the quarter the same evening.

watchlist.label: FQ4-26
watchlist.note: print_at inferred from 46 8-K 2.02 acceptances: min in-band gap 91d of last 6 (91, 91, 91, 91, 91, 91), early-biased; last print 2026-07-30 20:30Z. Verify against company IR.
